newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates Krungthai Thanakit at BBB minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Krungthai Thanakit at BBB minus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday that it assigned a BBB minus long-term and A3 short-term rating to Krungthai Thanakit Plc, with a negative rating outlook.

The ratings agency said the rating reflects KTT's ownership by Krung Thai Bank, and indirectly the government of Thailand, and also its position as one of the larger and better performing Thai finance and securities companies.

"The negative rating outlook reflects concerns about the continuing instability in the Thai economy, property, and financial markets, and the continued pressure this will place on future earnings and asset quality," S&P said.
It said the rating assigned to KTT also considered its weaker business and, in some areas, its financial profile compared to its peers, particularly the larger commercial banks.
"These are offset by the benefits derived from ownership and the significant role KTT is performing in the ongoing restructure and rationalization of the Thai finance and securities company sector.
"Standard and Poor's believes that, if needed, KTT would receive financial support from the government," it said.
